per_question.question: How is the Exit Fee defined under the Network 1 affiliate office agreement?
per_question.expected_answer: 18 months of net recurring revenue per transferring merchant normally paid to Affiliate.
per_question.answer:
The Exit Fee is defined in Section 7.6(c) of Source [Source 4], which states:

"all out of pocket and reasonable reimbursement of staff expenses shall be paid prior to the Transfer of the Merchants from NET1 or Affiliate, as defined in section 7.6(c) below."

However, for the Exit Fee itself, it is defined as follows (from Source [Source 2]):

"The amount of the Exit Fee during and following the termination of this Agreement shall be defined as the following: (1) the aggregate sum, per transferring merchant, equal to eighteen (18) months net recurring revenue normally paid to Affiliate under the compensation terms of this Agreement to a maximum of $250,000."

This definition is for the Exit Fee during and following termination, not specifically for the Exit Fee related to Source [Source 4]. The specific Exit Fee in Source [Source 4] appears to be defined as "as defined in section 7.6(c) below," but without further details provided in the given sources.
